test_configuration.restriction: Limits existing canonical GetSteamAccountID account keys. It does not identify physical computers or independently authenticate Steam users/game servers. A dedicated test service must refuse to start when this setting is absent or invalid.

existing_reusable_components.use: Pinned-host SSH transport and ownership-checked loopback tunnel.
existing_reusable_components.limit: Currently fixes both local and remote port to 8765. Do not launch unchanged for an isolated 18765 service.

existing_reusable_components.use: Private temporary KV injection of the server ConVar in a local Tools/template_map session; removes the temporary credential file and does not print the token.
existing_reusable_components.limit: Readiness is fixed to localhost:8765 and the temporary file is placed in the developer addon. It requires explicit isolated endpoint/addon adaptation and cannot provision secrets to Valve-hosted servers.

existing_reusable_components.use: Startup-parsed optional four-account gate at the account-to-database boundary.
existing_reusable_components.limit: An account allowlist supplements existing trusted server authentication. It does not make a public caller-supplied account_id trustworthy.

existing_reusable_components.use: Existing deny-all HTTPS proxy starting point.
existing_reusable_components.limit: The old route list omits current session, lottery, batch and leaderboard routes; do not enable it unchanged.

next_deployment_steps: Record the actual Workshop item ID and selected hosting mode. Keep the current test upload restricted; an upload/download test is distinct from a successful four-client online test.

For a self-controlled test host, prepare a separate loopback-only archive process at 127.0.0.1:18765, a separate PostgreSQL instance at 127.0.0.1:15432 with a new volume/password, and independent /opt/goufayu-ws4 and /etc/goufayu-ws4 paths. Do not copy real player rows, payment data or production credentials.

Reuse exact audited backend source, verifying every copied file against the active release manifest first. tmp/benefits_20261021/release_candidate/backend contains the current-generation server/PostgreSQL/session code; the external D:/survival_database/backend tree is older. Preserve the approved settlement bundle and match its hash to the test client.

Include the four-account gate and the environment value above in the isolated service. Validate a nonempty list before any application startup RPC. Generate new credentials only inside private host configuration after the concrete deployment has been reviewed. Do not install or proxy a payment service for this test.

Configure and verify a separate test HTTPS hostname/certificate only when DNS and the trusted host egress are known. Keep ingress denied until the host authorization is ready. Proxy only the required game routes; keep health/readiness local, retain Bearer checks, bound requests, and exclude credentials/bodies from logs.

For a self-controlled host, adapt the existing tunnel/private-ConVar helper to the isolated service and actual test addon. Never run the unchanged 8765 bridge and claim it is isolated. The upload contains no secret.

For Valve hosting, the existing private-ConVar helper is unavailable. A Workshop-bound dedicated-server authentication/bootstrap mechanism must be reviewed and pinned before public archive access; the current project has no such implementation. Do not auto-trust the first anonymous key or copy a shared backend token into downloadable Lua/JS.

Before opening test ingress, exercise authentication failures, the four allowed account keys, rejection of a fifth account, operation replay, concurrent requests and restart persistence against the isolated database. Then test the uploaded template_map build on the actual four computers.
not_performed: Backend deployment, database/container initialization, DNS/certificate changes or public interface activation.
Configuration of credentials on Valve-hosted game servers.
Four physical computer sessions or a successful uploaded-game end-to-end test.
